info.long_name: Number of students enrolled
info.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
info.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

info.long_name: Why N_enrolled carries a bound or no value on this row
info.short_description: Whether N_enrolled was published as a number, suppressed, not reported, or censored at a bound.
info.long_description: Per-measure companion to N_enrolled. BLANK means the source printed a figure and nothing is censored -- only the exceptions carry text. "suppressed" means the source withheld the cell to protect a small count (an asterisk run: "*", "**", "***"). "missing" means it was not reported at all ("N/A", "--", "NR"). "top_coded" means the source printed an upper bound such as ">95%" instead of a figure, so the true value lies ABOVE the bound; the rate column holds the bound the source printed, not a substitute invented for it, so it must be read as interval-censored rather than as a measurement. "bottom_coded" is the same the other way ("<5"). "suppressed" and "missing" both leave the rate empty but are not the same thing: a suppressed cell has a real measurement behind it that the state chose not to print, whereas a missing one was never collected.
